system.description: Along with an ornate astrological device. Damage Rating: 4 Critical Rating: 4 Group: Staff Qualities: Attuned 2, Defensive, Magic Encumbrance: 4 The staff is attuned to the Wind of Azyr. Celestial Wizards may add {Dc} to Channelling and Spellcraft checks. Once per session, a Celestial Order wizard wielding a celestial staff may remove a number of recharge tokens from his currently recharging Celestial Order spells equal to his character rank.
